name: jeans_rasgado
notes: Same approved lowr_001_r base; original model/UV/weights/LODs/materials preserved. Independent variation, component 4 only.
Front reference mapped to native silhouette. Back textile inferred from unprinted supplied waist fabric, retaining native pocket/fold shading.
Frayed tears are visual artwork in the diffuse texture; the native mesh has no new openings. Supplied tears are restricted to front and not repeated on the back.
Back weave uses the supplied cloth crop tone (20th RGB percentile) and 4% fiber contrast to avoid repeating photographic whiskers; native normal/specular and fold shading remain.
